nameOrigin: rodent known for emitting a foul smell

pokedexEntries.di: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

pokedexEntries.prl: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

pokedexEntries.pt: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

pokedexEntries.bw: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

pokedexEntries.x: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

pokedexEntries.or: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

pokedexEntries.y: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

pokedexEntries.as: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

pokedexEntries.sw: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

pokedexEntries.sh: It digs holes in the ground to make its nest. The stench of the fluid it lets fly from the tip of its tail is extremely potent.

pokedexEntries.bd: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. It can fire this spray more than 160 feet.

pokedexEntries.shp: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester in its belly.

pokedexEntries.la: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

pokedexEntries.sc: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

pokedexEntries.vi: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.
